_comment: Published by the device to v1/devices/me/attributes on connect and whenever any of these change. current_fw_* are ThingsBoard's own reserved OTA keys, not names this protocol chose. tank1.calibration* is new/unconfirmed (zhongchengyeweiyi#42 待办1, yeweiyi-cloud#14) — tank2 deliberately omits it to also exercise the 'no calibration attribute yet' case ParseTankCalibration must handle.
